def move_one_ball(arr):
    if not arr:
        return True
    n = len(arr)
    # Check where the break occurs
    break_point = -1
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] > arr[(i + 1) % n]:
            if break_point != -1:  # More than one break, impossible to sort
                return False
            break_point = i
    return True
